findings.detail: An active finance_viewer with required brand membership can update a draft mission through the authenticated SQL role.
findings.evidenceLayer: Local SQL claim substitute, not hosted JWT

limitations: in-process PGlite, not hosted PostgreSQL/Auth/RLS runtime acceptance
Auth claims and Storage schema/functions are local substitutes
kb_chunks.embedding uses text; vector index and match_kb_chunks are excluded
platform event triggers and owner/grantor identities are not reconstructed
no customer data copied; existing application tables start empty
atomicBootstrapChecks: first login and retry preserve the stored identity and existing balance
cross-workspace call rejects without an extra balance row
anon and authenticated cannot invoke the privileged bootstrap
injected second-balance failure leaves no creator or first-balance row
same request can recover after a fully rolled-back failure
limits: Real Auth/JWT and two-connection deletion/first-login races are not tested by PGlite.
